name: partner-finance-wlt-readback-cod
executionConcern: Partner wallet, settlement, commission, payout destination and COD custody through the governed DSH/WLT boundary
objective: Ensure Partner financial presentation reads canonical actor-scoped WLT truth, keeps settlement and commission authority out of frontend/DSH, and proves Partner COD remit is authenticated, idempotent, audited, reconciled and WLT-owned.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns wallet, ledger, settlement, commission, payout, COD custody and reconciliation; DSH supplies bounded operational evidence/proxy references only.

tasks.objective: Close Partner finance and COD vertically at WLT truth owner
tasks.currentProblem: The Partner finance bridge exposes real WLT-facing capabilities, but static frontend composition and a successful DSH proxy response do not prove WLT authorization, legal state, ledger posting, audit or reconciliation.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace wallet/settlement/commission/payout reads and COD remit through DSH application boundary to authenticated WLT domain, service-owned database, ledger/audit/reconciliation and canonical readback; correct the first authoritative divergence.
tasks.targetState: Every Partner financial value/status is WLT-owned and actor-scoped; COD remit is retry-safe, auditable, reconciled and reflected by canonical WLT-backed readback.
tasks.action: Fix WLT owner/invariants first, then migrate only affected DSH proxy, Partner and finance-operator consumers; remove any local calculation or final-success fallback when proven obsolete.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate authoritative settlement, commission or balance in DSH/frontend.
Do not expose unmasked payout destination identifiers to unauthorized consumers.
Do not treat a proof-reference string or DSH HTTP success as final financial completion without WLT reconciliation.
Do not broaden independent Captain/Field finance unless shared code is proven affected.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner finance reads are actor-scoped and WLT-backed.
COD remit replays cannot duplicate ledger effects and illegal states fail closed.
Every financial success is backed by canonical WLT readback/audit/reconciliation where required.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused financial consumer/proxy changes or roll forward at WLT while preserving ledger, audit and reconciliation evidence; never restore DSH/frontend financial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U007 implementation commit after WLT owner correction, bounded proxy/readback migration and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Close financial failure, privacy and reconciliation recovery paths
tasks.currentProblem: Happy-path finance rendering does not prove unknown outcomes, reconciliation mismatches, payout-destination masking/versioning or cross-actor denial remain safe.
tasks.requiredChange: Add or repair actor isolation, masked readback, legal state/replay checks, unknown/reconcilable outcome handling and refresh/restart behavior for Partner finance/COD.
tasks.targetState: Unknown/mismatched financial outcomes remain unresolved/reconcilable, sensitive identifiers stay protected, and refresh reconstructs authoritative WLT state without fabricated success.
tasks.action: Change only current Partner/WLT financial boundary and directly affected operator consumers; preserve unrelated finance capabilities.
mustNotChange: Do not log secrets/full financial identifiers.
Do not convert unknown provider/WLT outcome to local success.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown/reconciliation cases remain explicit and auditable.
Sensitive payout data is masked/revealed only by governed authorization.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation/proxy recovery changes while retaining WLT ledger/audit/reconciliation truth.
